summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload from an ESLint config package
details: @qlik/eslint-config-svelte@0.1.1 declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs", which downloads the Bun runtime (pinned v1.3.13) from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmod 0755's the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync on the sibling file math_init.js (or execs `bun math_init.js` directly if Bun is already on PATH). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` and heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function `WV8StW` performs the array shift, identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `bc3Kak` are mangled) — designed to run only under the Bun runtime, hiding its contents from Node-based inspection. The package presents itself as a Svelte ESLint config under the @qlik npm scope, but shipping a Bun-only obfuscated bundle and pulling in a second language runtime at preinstall has no relationship to ESLint configuration. Legitimate @qlik ESLint config packages are declared as dependencies while the actual on-install surface is this dropper. The full attack chain fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
